Package org.jdesktop.lg3d.apps.games.sudoku

Class SudokuModel

java.lang.Object
org.jdesktop.lg3d.apps.games.sudoku.SudokuModel
public class SudokuModel extends Object
Pure sudoku engine: generates a random full grid, digs a unique-solution puzzle out of it, and tracks the working grid the player edits. No lg3d / AWT dependency, so generation and solving can be exercised headlessly.

Cells are addressed 0..80 as row * 9 + col; a value of 0 is blank. newPuzzle(int) builds a fresh board with the requested number of givens, guaranteeing a single solution by re-testing uniqueness after each dig. isSolved() is true only when the grid is complete and free of row/column/box conflicts.
